# Nuria Guevara

> Nuria Guevara (full name: Nuria Guevara Fuentes) is a Spanish Full-Stack Web Developer specialized in React, Node.js, and WordPress. Before web development she spent over a decade working in communication. She currently works as a web developer and is studying a Master's Degree in Web Development with AI.

## Projects (case studies)

- [SafeMap](https://www.nuriaguevarafuentes.com/safemap): Collaborative risk-zone map for travelers. React, Node.js, MongoDB, Express, JWT.
- [Past In Pixels](https://www.nuriaguevarafuentes.com/otrosproyectos/pastinpixels): Final Degree Project — a React web experience fusing history and technology.
- [PalMotion](https://www.nuriaguevarafuentes.com/otrosproyectos/palmotion): Fitness app built with Python and Streamlit.
- [Movie Selector](https://www.nuriaguevarafuentes.com/otrosproyectos/movieselector): Vanilla JavaScript app consuming an external movie API.
- [Eagles in Spain](https://www.nuriaguevarafuentes.com/otrosproyectos/eaglesinspain): Her first PHP project, built for the Spanish Philadelphia Eagles fan community.
